paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 38b: he came to the Exilarch’s house, and Rav Zevid said to them: “Do not listen to him,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Avodah Zarah 38b paragraph fully names Rabbi Chiyya Parva’ah and Rav Zevid. Chiyya comes to the Exilarch’s house and Zevid tells the people not to listen to him, supporting the local title and direction. No further legal discussion or subsequent events are imported.
